{{Quote|Whatever happened here, it looks it was one ''heck'' of a ''fight''. <br /> "The last thing we need right now is ''another'' battle, ''Commander''.|[[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], after their supply run on Morton|<ref name="LT">{{SWComicCite|7.12|Leia's Trust}}</ref>}}
'''Morton''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Majoor sector/Legends|Majoor sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Silam Dunerz]] knew that [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] would be returning from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']]. In an effort to capture the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]], the [[Supply Master/Legends|Supply Master]] laid a [[Skirmish aboard the Redemption|trap]] on her route.<ref name="LT" />
